info.name: Amazon CloudFormation Stacks API
info.description:
Amazon CloudFormation is an infrastructure as code service that enables you to model, provision, and manage AWS and third-party resources by treating infrastructure as code. You use templates to define your resources and their dependencies, then deploy them as stacks.

Contact Support:
 Name: Amazon Web Services
